digest.component_or_area: store auto-push and ticket event security
propositions: A rejected tickets-branch auto-push fails silently because the rejection reason is captured then discarded, and the failure is misrouted as retriable non-fast-forward via an over-broad `rejected` substring match in the classifier regex.
Ticket event payloads containing credentials (such as raw environment output in comments) are never scanned for secrets on write, only code is scanned via gitleaks at review gate.

The divergence signal PUSH_PENDING is computed only during explicit `rebar fsck`, never on subsequent writes, so a push failure is reported once then never re-announced despite an escalating unpushed-commit backlog.

The best-effort contract requires rejected pushes to warn the caller so the divergence is not silent, but three separate code paths (async with stderr=DEVNULL, library NullHandler, MCP tool result) make the warning undeliverable even when generated.

A policy-rejection classifier modelled on prior art in _ref_lock.py distinguishes terminal rejections (hook declined, push protection, rate limit) from retriable non-fast-forwards so failures self-identify with the git reason and unpushed count.
